headers: BTU will enter the estimated annual Class 2 and Class 0 glove testing quantities in the blue cells before the bid is issued; those two glove quantities must total approximately 1,000 pairs. BTU has approximately 2 physical pairs of rubber insulating sleeves, and each pair will be tested every six months, resulting in an estimated 4 sleeve pair-testing services per year. Bidders shall enter per-pair prices in the yellow cells. Each pair contains two individual items, and each item must be individually cleaned, inspected, electrically tested, marked, and documented. Replacement glove pricing is required per pair but is NOT included in determining the low bid.
